TimeHint:
A time the user stated: which day relative to today, and the hour or the part of the
day they named. Never a date, and never a clock the user did not say.
TimeHint.day_offset: 0 for today, -1 for yesterday, -7 for this day last week
TimeHint.clock: Local time of day as HH:MM, only from an hour the user said; null otherwise
TimeHint.part_of_day: The part of the day the user named, or the one a meal they named is eaten in, when they said no hour; null otherwise
Mention: One thing the user logged, and the one pillar that records it.
Mention.pillar: Id of the one pillar that records this thing
Mention.said: Every word the user said about this one thing: what, how much, how, when
Mention.occurred_at_hint: When the user said this one thing happened, or null if unstated
PassOne.language: BCP-47 tag the sentence begins in; the sentence may mix languages
PassOne.is_health_related: False for anything that is not a log
PassOne.states_a_lasting_fact: True when the person states something about themselves that stays true beyond this one log; false for a log of what happened
PassOne.mentions: Every thing the user logged, each once, under the one pillar that records it
PassOne.headline: This log in a few words, as its person would title it, in each language
TranscribedPassOne: Your answer about one log that you hear or see, and so write down first.
TranscribedPassOne.transcript: Exactly what was said, in its own language
